items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of household help
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026, sent by post. Per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X cited in the letter, a letter counts as bekannt gegeben (delivered) on the 4th day after dispatch. Dispatch day = 19.11.2026 (Thu). 19.11 + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Mon), which is a normal business day in NW, so Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period runs from that event: under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (23.11.) is not counted, so the period starts 24.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a monthly period ending under § 187 Abs.1 ends on the day of the last month whose number corresponds to the day of the triggering event, i.e. the 23rd of the following month = 23.12.2026 (Wed), which is a working day in NW (no holiday). Final due date: 2026-12-23.
